comments.text:
Complete & utter bollocks!! I've been to Anticosti Island, it isn't horseshoe shaped as pictured above! There are roughly 35K deer not 100K,  & you can hunt them so the Island is not at all forbidden! In fact the island has a significant tourist business for sightseeing, hunting, & fishing
 
• Main Settlement: Almost all permanent residents live in the primary village of Port-Menier on the western tip of the island.
• Seasonal Population: The population increases during the summer months with seasonal workers, researchers, and roughly 8,000 tourists and hunters.

Natural & Geological Wealth (What makes it rich in value)

• Shale Oil and Gas: The island sits on the Macasty Shale formation, which past estimates suggested could contain tens of billions of dollars in oil and gas reserves (valued at $46 billion to $48 billion in potential future economic benefits over decades).
• Oil Drilling Ban: The Quebec government permanently halted oil and gas exploration on the island and paid millions in compensation to cancel permits ($41.4 million) to protect its environment and secure its heritage status.
• UNESCO World Heritage Site: Inscribed in 2023, the island is globally renowned for containing the world's most complete and best-preserved fossil and sedimentary rock records from the Ordovician-Silurian extinction 445 million years ago.
• Wildlife & Tourism: It functions as a premier destination for wilderness tourism, salmon fishing, and white-tailed deer hunting managed largely by Sépaq.
